title: Noobs Must Die
features:
kill all
give items
-- Combat Tab

> Kill Aura: Automatically attacks all nearby enemies within a defined range.
> Kill Aura Distance: Slider to adjust the maximum detection range for Kill Aura.
> Give Everyone Windforce: Grants the "Windforce" skill to all players in the server.

-- Game Tab

> Select Power Up: Dropdown list of available power ups to give.
> Amount to Give: Slider to choose how many power ups to grant.
> Give Power Ups: Gives the selected power up to the local player.

-- Player Tab

> Select Fighter: Dropdown to choose a fighter character.
> Equip Fighter: Equips the selected fighter and starts the game.
